simple.meaning: סָעַף (çâʻaph) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to disbranch (a tree).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 10:33. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סָעַף (H5586) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: סָעַף (çâʻaph) / H5586 is traced through Isaiah 10:33 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H5586. saaph I. [ סֵעֵף ] verb Pi`el denominative lop off boughs ; — Participle מֻּארָה סְסָעֵף Isa 10:33 ׳י֗֗֗ shall lop off (the) crown of branches.
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; properly, to divide up; but used only as denominative from 5585 ,

occurrences.englishText: Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.
